Our Comoros journey ends today, but a completely new African adventure begins — MADAGASCAR !
Before leaving Comoros, we meet Khalid Bhai once again and talk about some fascinating aspects of life here — the Indian community, safety, business, property and the unique Comorian wedding tradition where couples can celebrate marriage again with a huge “Grand Marriage”.
Then begins the real travel adventure.
